title: Onigiri Mod
description: This mod adds Onigiri to Minecraft
body:
Minecraft now features **Onigiri**, which you can make from tuna or chicken.  
The mod also adds rice, which you can use to make onigiri.  
![Onigiri](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/235e29fea218af58da72e357d033b1f4d09ea153.png)

**The mod adds:**
> 
> Onigiri  
> 
> Can
> 
> Tuna  
> 
> Tuna meat  
> 
> Sliced ​​chicken 
> 
> Rice  
> 
> Can of tuna
> 

![Tuna](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0300c1914c56f49253d91821781d511871cde1fb_0.webp)

If you need Onigiri in your world, download this mod!

Thanks for reading the description **_:)_**
